description: Contributions to general IIP y/y, percentage points, monthly from April 2024, for each part of the general index: the 23 NIC 2-digit manufacturing divisions, mining, electricity and gas, water and waste; weight × (index − index a year earlier) ÷ general index a year earlier, at MoSPI's 2022-23 weights (calculated by Asia Decoded). With each part's weight and MoSPI's published y/y. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_contrib_items.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India IIP contributions by industry
